messages:
dylan: Heads-up — noticed console routing affinity metrics diverging from what the Python SDK is sending. Quota attribution for two customer tenants moved to the wrong cost center this morning.
alex: Which headers are we seeing on the wire vs what console expects?
meera: We rolled a sampling/telemetry header rename in the routing proxy during the last canary: `route-hint` -> `route-policy`. SDKs were supposed to normalize but looks like the py client still emits the old name when fallback enabled.
sasha: Correct — `route-migration-v2` flag flipped in prod yesterday. Most traffic goes through proxy that expects `route-policy` but console attribution pipeline also accepts `route-hint` in legacy mode. The intersection is small but enough to skew quotas.
dylan: Example from a failing request (from Python client):
```
GET /v1/generate
Headers:
  Authorization: Bearer x
  X-Route-Hint: tenant:acme,priority:low
  Content-Type: application/json
```
console parsing expected `X-Route-Policy` casing/format.
sam: Is this causing billing/quota enforcement to miscount? We had a billing alert for tenant acme.
meera: Yes — the quota-collector dedup logic keys by normalized header name. If it sees `X-Route-Policy` it attributes to the new cost center; `X-Route-Hint` keeps the old mapping. So some tokens were billed under the legacy bucket.
alex: Short-term options: (1) patch console/router to accept both headers and normalize, (2) hotfix Python SDK to emit both names for a release window, (3) toggle rollback of `route-migration-v2` canary. Tradeoffs: (1) is safest centrally, (2) faster rollout to customers, (3) is more disruptive.
sasha: We should avoid a full rollback unless necessary. Suggest (1) + (2): make the routing/attribution service accept both keys for 30 days and ship SDK fixes for py/ts. Go SDK isn't affected because it's on the newer client lib.
dylan: I can draft the console change — will add header-normalization middleware that lowercases and maps legacy names to canonical `route-policy` before attribution. I'll also add a telemetry flag to the attribution event: `header_source: [sdk|proxy|legacy]` so we can debug.
meera: I'll own SDK patches. Plan: py SDK v1.12.3 add a compatibility shim that emits `X-Route-Policy` and preserves `X-Route-Hint` for one release. TS SDK similar. We'll include opt-in behind client config `normalizeRouteHeader: true` and default to true for the patch.
alex: CI note — instrument console dashboard to show a split of matches by header name (new vs legacy) for the next week.
ci-bot: deploy started: routing-attrib-normalizer v0.3.1 -> canary (us-west-2) by sasha at 4921000018
sam: Also file a billing incident ticket so finance can reconcile charges for acme. JIRA-1234 created.
dylan: OK sounds good. Timeline: console middleware today, canary this afternoon, SDK patches tomorrow morning. Meera please coordinate release notes so customers know about the header normalization.
meera: Will do. I'll also ping support to expect a handful of tickets.
alex: Thanks — please post updates here once canary passes. :thumbsup:
ci-bot: canary succeeded in us-west-2 at 4921000036
